chunks.arabic_text: رِجَالُ الْكَشِّيِّ: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ قُولَوَيْهَ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ وَمُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَهْزَارٍ، عَنْ فَضَالَةَ بْنِ أَيُّوبَ الْأَزْدِيِّ، عَنْ أَبَانَ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ قَالَ

translations.en: Rijal al-Kashi: Muhammad b. Qulawayh, from Sa'd b. Abdallah, from Ya'qub b. Yazid and Muhammad b. Isa, from Ali b. Mahziyar, from Fadhala b. Ayyub al-Azdi, from Aban b. Uthman who said:

chunks.arabic_text: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ يَقُولُ: لَعَنَ اللَّهُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ سَبْإٍ، إِنَّهُ ادَّعَى الرَّبُوبِيَّةَ فِي أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، وَكَانَ وَ اللَّهِ أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ عَبْدًا لِلَّهِ طَائِعًا، الْوَيْلُ لِمَنْ كَذَبَ عَلَيْنَا، وَإِنَّ قَوْمًا يَقُولُونَ فِينَا مَا لَا نَقُولُهُ فِي أَنْفُسِنَا، نَبْرَأُ إِلَى اللَّهِ مِنْهُمْ، نَبْرَأُ إِلَى اللَّهِ مِنْهُمْ

translations.en: I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) say: May Allah curse Abdallah b. Saba, for he claimed divinity for the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him), and by Allah, the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) was an obedient slave to Allah. Woe to the one who lies about us, and indeed a group says about us what we do not say about ourselves, we disassociate to Allah from them, we disassociate to Allah from them.

en.summary: This hadith from Al-Kashi’s *Rijal* highlights Abdallah ibn Saba’s pivotal role in early Shia theological development by attributing divine status (*rububiyya*) to Imam Ali, a claim the Imam explicitly rejects to affirm Ali’s status as a devoted servant (*abd*). The narration underscores the concept of *al-bara’ min al-mu’tazila* (disassociation from those who exaggerate in the Imams), establishing a baseline for distinguishing orthodox Shia belief from Ghalawa (exaggerators).
en.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq say about Abdallah b. Saba's claim regarding Imam Ali?

key_terms.عبد الله بن سبإ: Abdallah b. Saba, a companion of Ali known for his claims
key_terms.نبرأ إلى الله منهم: We disassociate to Allah from them
